 Order

This appeal has been filed by the appellants/claimants under Section 173(1) of Motor Vehicles Act,
1988, is arising out of award dated 18.02.2021 passed by Member, MACT, Dharampuri, District - Dhar (MP), in Claim Case No.99/2018 on account of inadequacy of compensation and seeking enhancement of compensation.
(2) The date of accident, negligence and the issue of liability is not in dispute, however the finding recorded by the Tribunal in this regard is not in question.

As per the finding of the Tribunal in the case of death of appellant/claimant - Vilas Rao, the amount of compensation has allowed accepting earning of Rs.5500/- per month and the total compensation is awarded Rs.10,96,376/- with interest.

(3) Counsel for the appellant contended that the compensation awarded by the Tribunal accepting earning of Rs.5500/- per month by the deceased is inadequate looking to the fact that he was skilled labour, however, expecting the earning of Rs.6200/- per month on adding future prospects and applying the adequate multiplier he prays for reasonable amount of compensation may be awarded to him.

2 (4) Per contra, counsel for the respondent No.3 - Insurance Company contended that Tribunal has rightly awarded the compensation and argued in support of the finding recorded by the Tribunal.

sentences.text: (5) After hearing counsel for the parties and on perusal of the record, in the considered opinion of this Court, the just and proper amount of income of the deceased in the present case would be Rs.6200/- per month and after deducting one fourth amount towards personal expenses and after applying the appropriate multiplier the loss of dependency comes to Rs.97641/-.
(6) After adding compensation towards conventional head i.e. Rs.2,30,000/-, the total amount of compensation comes to Rs.1206416/-.
On reducing the amount already awarded, the enhanced amount comes to Rs.110040/-.
(7) In the result, the appeal is allowed in part and to the extent indicated here-in-above.

The enhanced amount i.e. Rs.110040/- shall carry interest @ 9% per annum from the date of filing of the claim petition till its realization and the finding in respect of liability awarded by the Tribunal shall remain intact.
(8) The appellant has valued the appeal for Rs.10,00,000/- and paid the court fees of Rs.2500/-.However the remaining amount is Rs.10040/-.

The court fees shall be paid by the appellant within a period of one month from the amount released by the Insurance Company and in case if the additional court fee is not deposited within three months from today, the claimant would be required to pay interest of 8% on the court fee.
